sources.title: Otter.ai raises $320 million from General Catalyst’s growth fund for its meeting tool

cards.summary: Meeting note-taking tool Otter.ai announced on Tuesday that it has raised $320 million from General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund (CVF), which provides capital to startups without diluting equity and gets returns on the results of marketing spend. Otter.ai said that it will use these funds for enterprise growth, go-to-market strategy, international expansion, and product innovation.

sources.title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says

cards.summary: The idea of embedded evaluators — in which supposedly "neutral" third-party observers are placed inside AI organizations — has been popularized over the last several months, as AI labs grapple with a rash of safety incidents that have spurred concerns over the potential harms of their technology.
cards.title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says

sources.title: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents

cards.summary: A hacker broke into more than 100 websites using an army of AI agents that mostly operated on their own, according to findings from the AI security firm Norforge . Though Norforge doesn't name the targets, Reuters reports that the victims included companies like John Deere, SharkNinja, and Cummins.
cards.title: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents

sources.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts

cards.summary: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.

sources.title: Meta pauses Muse sharing after researchers find AI chats on the web

cards.summary: Meta says it paused a Muse feature that lets you share conversations with the AI assistant after researchers found the URLs publicly available on the web, as reported by Ars Technica . In a report published this week , researchers at the security firm Claroc say they found more than 6,800 Muse links through public DNS records.
cards.title: Meta pauses Muse sharing after researchers find AI chats on the web

sources.title: Spotify pulled 50 million AI slop and spam tracks from its recommendations

cards.summary: Spotify says it has removed more than 50 million songs considered AI-generated slop or spam from user recommendations over the past year. That's according to an announcement on Tuesday that says Spotify has also made changes to its recommendation system to highlight more music made by human artists.
cards.title: Spotify pulled 50 million AI slop and spam tracks from its recommendations
